name: Mike Hickey
bio: I have always worked in and enjoyed the construction industry. The knowledge that we are actually building something that is useful and lasting is very satisfying. I enjoy working with the good people at Coinford who share the passion for excellence and providing a “community” spirit amongst our workers.

name: Gerry Hickey
bio: As Co-owner and co-founder of the business from the beginning, I believe in building strong relationships endorsed with trust. I am a firm believer in delivering certainty and surety for the clients. I also pride myself in keeping close to my workforce and my fellow directors.

name: Paul Timlin
bio: I joined Coinford in 2001 as a buyer in the procurement office and by 2008 had significant involvement with commercial and operational matters across the business. As Coinford continued to grow I progressed to Managing Director in January 2014 and CEO in 2024.

I am passionate about our industry; embracing new technologies and ensuring the training and development of our people remains a key priority. I am relationship focused, and years of experience working closely with clients & suppliers has enabled an extremely strong network across the construction industry.

name: Rick Santana
bio: I joined Coinford in 2025 as CFO. I bring a wealth of experience in construction from large PLC’s, PE, to successfully run family organisations. Key skills include driving strategic growth, having collegiate teams and understanding the end goal so as a team it can be achieved.

I enjoy seeing the life cycle of a project from conception to completion, the achievements of many driving toward the same goal which has a “can do” culture which makes Coinford an exceptional place to work.

name: Panos Panayiotou
bio: I am seasoned construction professional with over 30 years of experience in the industry. As Operations Director at Coinford, I have overseen all aspects of construction operations, from project planning to completion. I have a strong background in civil engineering, infrastructure, groundworks & RC Frame, and strive to bring my knowledge and expertise to every project I undertake.

Prior to joining Coinford in 2012, I held Senior Management / Director positions at several leading construction firms, where I honed my skills in team leadership, contract negotiation, and strategic planning. Strong client relationships and working collaboratively with the entire project team is where my focus is to achieve project success.
I hold a 2-1 BSc Civil Engineering and MSc Civil Engineering degree from Greenwich University, as well as other vocational accreditation

name: Brendan Keilthy
bio: I am a Chartered Civil Engineer and Chartered Construction Manager with over 17 years experience in the industry. I joined the board in 2022 and bring a fresh perspective to winning work. The early part of my career was spent in a main contracting capacity, with project delivery responsibility across multiple disciplines in complex & challenging operations, before moving into senior roles within Pre-Construction. I am passionate about early client engagement, building lasting relationships, developing high performing teams and delivering what we promise.

name: Ruth Rees
bio: With over a decade of experience in Human Resources, I am dedicated to fostering a people-first culture at Coinford. Guided by our commitment to professionalism, integrity, and excellence, I lead initiatives that support continuous learning, employee satisfaction and recognition. By aligning HR strategies with our core values, I strive to make Coinford not just the contractor of choice, but also the employer of choice for our people.

name: Craig Moorcroft
bio: I joined Coinford in 2013 and I have over 25 years experience in the RC frame and Groundworks industries, as well as previously working for a main contractor. I am responsible for Health and Safety across the group, creating and implementing our H&S policies and procedures.
I strive for continuous improvement of our H&S performance and compliance, achieving accident statistic KPI’s below the industry sector average.

name: Shaun O’Donnell
bio: Having joined Coinford in April 2021, I bring 24 years of IT experience to the team. My expertise encompasses diverse disciplines, including IT Service Delivery and Management, Project Management, and Strategic Deployments, acquired across various business sectors, including IT Managed Services, Property Management, and Formula One. I apply my experience to review and deliver suitable technology to Coinford, aiming to simplify day-to-day workloads and enhance overall efficiency within the organisation.

name: Lee Sackett
bio: I’ve spent over 24 years in management, backed by a strong mechanical background. I joined the company more than a decade ago as Workshop Manager and have since progressed to Plant Director. My role is all about keeping our fleet safe, reliable, and cost-effective — making sure our sites have the right equipment when and where they need it. I enjoy developing people and systems that drive efficiency and accountability, and I take real pride in seeing those improvements make a difference across the business.
